stories.title: Abin alerta governo e TSE sobre nível 'crítico' de escalada de pressão dos EUA contra o Brasil nas eleições

en.title: Abin alerts government and TSE about 'critical' level of US pressure escalation against Brazil in elections
en.summary: Brazil's intelligence agency raised concerns about potential US influence and interference in the 2026 elections to a critical level in a confidential report to government and electoral authorities.

stories.title: Lula ou Flávio? Para Câmara Italiana de Comércio atratividade do País não depende das eleições

en.title: Lula or Flávio? For Italian Chamber of Commerce, country's attractiveness does not depend on elections
en.summary: According to the Italian Chamber of Commerce, Brazil's economic attractiveness remains independent of the electoral outcome.

stories.title: MP sobre bets une até clubes antagônicos e que buscam pressão popular para pressionar Governo

en.title: Bill on betting unites even antagonistic clubs seeking popular pressure to pressure Government
en.summary: A legislative proposal regarding sports betting has brought together opposing football clubs in their efforts to exert public pressure on the government.

stories.title: Campanha de Lula estimula ‘missões’ diárias para militância reagir à alta de Flávio nas pesquisas

en.title: Lula's campaign stimulates daily 'missions' for activists to react to Flávio's rise in polls
en.summary: The Lula campaign is organizing daily grassroots activities for supporters to counter a rival candidate's growing momentum in polling numbers.

stories.title: Fusões na China podem ameaçar mercado de carros elétricos no Brasil? Entenda

en.title: Could mergers in China threaten the electric car market in Brazil? Understand
en.summary: The headline raises the question of whether consolidation among Chinese automakers could impact Brazil's electric vehicle market.

stories.title: Pressão de Trump sobre Brasil é parte de plano para interferir em eleições da América Latina, diz professor

en.title: Trump's pressure on Brazil is part of plan to interfere in Latin American elections, says professor
en.summary: A professor argues that the Trump administration is pressuring other countries' political processes, with Brazil's case being part of a broader electoral interference strategy that includes demands in trade negotiations.

stories.title: Brasil será o grande teste para o uso de IA em eleições no mundo, diz executivo da OpenAI

en.title: Brazil will be the major test for AI use in elections worldwide, says OpenAI executive
en.summary: An OpenAI executive views Brazil's elections as a critical testing ground for artificial intelligence deployment in electoral processes, with implications for other countries' upcoming elections.

stories.title: Efeito China: preços dos 25 carros usados mais buscados no Brasil em 2026 caem até 15%

en.title: China effect: prices of 25 most-searched used cars in Brazil in 2026 fall up to 15%
en.summary: Used car prices in Brazil have declined significantly more than official indices reflect, with all top 25 most-searched used vehicles experiencing price drops over the past year due to Chinese vehicle imports and new car promotions.

stories.title: Advogado do Master encaminhou a Vorcaro foto de Gonet fumando charuto em Londres

en.title: Master's lawyer sent Vorcaro a photo of Gonet smoking a cigar in London
en.summary: A lawyer representing Master bank's interests forwarded to Vorcaro a photograph showing Gonet smoking a cigar in London.

stories.title: Conversas extraídas do celular de Vorcaro mostram Gonet e ex-banqueiro em noite de charutos e uísque em Londres

en.title: Conversations extracted from Vorcaro's phone show Gonet and former banker in night of cigars and whiskey in London
en.summary: Mobile phone messages between Vorcaro and lawyer Ciro Soares contain a photograph of Brazil's attorney general Paulo Gonet drinking whiskey and smoking cigars with the Master Bank owner.

stories.title: Racha familiar: irmãos Trad mudam de partido para apoiar Lula e Flávio

en.title: Family split: Trad brothers change parties to support Lula and Flávio
en.summary: In Mato Grosso do Sul, brothers Fábio, Marquinhos, and Nelson Trad Filho are pursuing opposing political paths in upcoming elections after years together in one of the state's most traditional political families.

stories.title: Teto e piso eleitorais se encontram para Lula e Flávio

en.title: Ceiling and floor meet for Lula and Flávio in electoral intentions
en.summary: Voting intention, rejection, and government approval curves have converged for Lula, suggesting the president has limited room for growth without improving his approval ratings.

stories.title: Proeminência de TV e rádio irrita 'big techs' porque ameaça venda de dados e negociação de espaço nobre

en.title: Prominence of TV and radio irritates big techs because it threatens data sales and premium space negotiation
en.summary: The prominence of traditional television and radio is concerning major technology companies due to potential impacts on data commercialization and advertising space negotiations.

stories.title: Trump receberá Xi Jinping no aeroporto e oferecerá jantar acompanhado de CEOs de big techs

en.title: Trump will receive Xi Jinping at airport and offer dinner accompanied by big tech CEOs
en.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump will host Chinese leader Xi Jinping for a state visit in Washington next week, with discussions focused on commercial negotiations and competition in artificial intelligence and strategic technologies.

stories.title: Secretária de Nunes anuncia reajuste a entidades em jantar com cartazes eleitorais da primeira-dama

en.title: Nunes' Secretary Announces Increase to Entities at Dinner with First Lady's Electoral Posters
en.summary: São Paulo's municipal social assistance secretary announced a 5.5% increase in transfers to dependent entities during a dinner surrounded by campaign materials for first lady Regina Nunes and former housing secretary Sidney Cruz, both running for office.

stories.title: Secretário do Tesouro dos EUA e vice-premier da China se reúnem em Nova York para tratar de IA e comércio

en.title: US Treasury Secretary and China Vice Premier Meet in New York to Discuss AI and Trade
en.summary: The US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent plans to meet with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng in New York to discuss artificial intelligence, trade, rare earth minerals, and economic matters between the two nations.

stories.title: 1ª Turma do STF tem maioria para manter condenação de Eduardo Bolsonaro em caso de coação

en.title: Brazilian Supreme Court's First Panel Has Majority to Uphold Eduardo Bolsonaro's Conviction in Coercion Case
en.summary: Brazil's Supreme Court First Panel formed a majority to reject the appeal from former deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro's defense, maintaining his conviction for coercion related to his actions in the United States.
